pages.text: A repeater listens on its $(thing)input$() frequency and sends what it hears out on its $(thing)output$(), so handhelds that cannot reach each other can talk through it. Handhelds listen on the output and transmit with an $(thing)offset$() (usually 600 kHz) to the input.

Set a $(l:radiocraft:repeaters/duplexer)duplexer$(/l) on top of it (its back or bottom work too). Run the antenna's coax from the duplexer, or from the ground straight behind the repeater, where the duplexer's cable comes down. Without one it deafens itself: "psht... psht...".$(br2)Settings: input/output, $(thing)CTCSS$() tones, CW ID, hang time and a timeout.
